name: fcp-mcp-server
summary: MCP server for Final Cut Pro XML. 13 grouped tools (88 operations): timeline analysis, batch editing, QC, generation, multi-track, NLE export, media relink, .fcpxmld bundles, real media analysis (silence, beats, shot boundaries, local Whisper or ElevenLabs transcripts), a SQLite cache, ffmpeg proxy preview with source-media verification, export watch-folder round-trip, EDL import, an operation journal with undo, a review gate on delivery, bulk organize, tiered shot search with offline captions.
